name: spline-pipe-straight
why: A spline path held to a closed form: collinear through-points make the chord-length cubic a straight line, so the pipe is a cylinder, 9 pi 30 = 848.230016 mm3. The exact B-rep reads 848.229790 (STEP probe), 2.7e-7 under: the swept wall is a B-spline surface MakePipeShell fits, not an analytic cylinder.
